sn34.10:1.4: bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ sātaccakārī
sn34.10:1.5: ca. tatra bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca samādhismiṃ sātaccakārī
sn34.10:1.6: ca. ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca uttamo
sn34.10:1.7: ca pavaro ca. seyyathāpi bhikkhave gavā khīraṃ …pe… pavaro cāti.
sn34.10:1.8: sāvatthī. cattārome bhikkhave jhāyī. katame cattāro. idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sappāyakārī. idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ sappāyakārī
